LanguageData.LP_Sub_BarbarianGeneral.label: barbarian general
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Berserker.label: Path of the Berserker
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Berserker.description: Raging for the slaughter: strikes faster while raging, an unshakable will, a glare that drives enemies off, and always hits back when struck.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_TotemWarrior.label: Path of the Totem Warrior
LanguageData.LP_Sub_TotemWarrior.description: Ally with the spirit of a totem animal (choose bear, eagle or wolf once, can't change); every ability changes with the totem.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_TotemWarrior.choices.0.label: totem
LanguageData.LP_Sub_TotemWarrior.choices.0.tips.0: While raging, all damage except psychic ×0.5; carry capacity ×2; spirit walker summons a grizzly; totemic attunement taunts nearby enemies.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_TotemWarrior.choices.0.tips.1: While raging, ranged hits against you ×0.7, movement ×1.2; ranged range +3; spirit walker summons eagle spirits (cassowary-shaped); totemic attunement glides while raging.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_TotemWarrior.choices.0.tips.2: While raging, allies within 5 cells get melee hit +15%; movement ×1.1, tracks fleeing enemies; spirit walker summons timber wolves; totemic attunement makes melee hits knock targets down.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_StormHerald.label: Path of the Storm Herald
LanguageData.LP_Sub_StormHerald.description: Become a storm while raging (choose desert fire, sea lightning or tundra ice once, can't change): nearby enemies keep taking damage, and allies get shelter.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_StormHerald.choices.0.label: storm
LanguageData.LP_Sub_StormHerald.choices.0.tips.0: Aura burns; fire damage ×0.5, max comfortable temperature +40°C; raging storm may ignite enemies.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_StormHerald.choices.0.tips.1: Aura shocks (EMP for mechanoids); lightning damage ×0.5, comfortable temperature ±20°C at both ends; raging storm may stun enemies.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_StormHerald.choices.0.tips.2: Aura frost; frost damage ×0.5, min comfortable temperature -40°C; raging storm may slow enemies.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_RogueGeneral.label: rogue general
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Assassin.label: Assassin
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Assassin.description: A one-hit-kill specialist: enemies not yet in combat take a critical hit, and downed or controlled targets are as good as dead.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Thief.label: thief
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Thief.description: Quick hands, quick feet, sharp eyes: pickpocketing, climbing over walls and roofs, finding treasure, and astonishingly fast in the first seconds of a fight.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_ArcaneTrickster.label: Arcane Trickster
LanguageData.LP_Sub_ArcaneTrickster.description: A rogue who learned some arcana: has their own mana (same rules as wizards), knows Mage Hand, Magic Missile, Invisibility and Sleep, and can steal enemies' spells.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_RangerGeneral.label: ranger general
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hunter.label: Hunter
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hunter.description: A hunter specializing in threats: pick a hunter's prey (level 3) and a defensive tactic (level 7), and can attack all nearby enemies at once.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hunter.choices.0.label: hunter's prey
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hunter.choices.0.tips.1: With 3 or more enemies up close, after a melee hit strike another adjacent enemy once more (once per second).
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hunter.choices.1.label: defensive tactics
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hunter.choices.1.tips.0: From the second hit by the same enemy within 3 seconds, damage ×0.5.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Hunter.choices.1.tips.1: Damage you can dodge, such as explosions and fire, ×0.5.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_BeastMaster.label: the Beastlord
LanguageData.LP_Sub_BeastMaster.description: Form a ranger's bond with an animal: it grows with you (beast level follows your adventurer level), learns tricks, doubles its attacks, and can share your buffs.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_GloomStalker.label: Gloom Stalker
LanguageData.LP_Sub_GloomStalker.description: A ranger who hunts in the dark: the first strike of each fight is the deadliest, hard to hit in darkness, a will of iron, and an instant follow-up on a miss.
